output_length_model_audit.source: calibration measurement phase, successful requests, server_output_tokens
output_length_model_audit.selection_limit: completed responses only; drain-censored requests have no realized length label

arrival_trace_source: requests.csv actual_send_sec joined to the trace request ID; scheduled trace time is used only when an actual send time is absent
output_length_semantics: trace output_tokens are max-token budgets; realized lengths are sampled from successful calibration responses conditioned on input length and budget; no seed-404 output lengths enter simulation
closed_loop_future_migration_leakage_che: closed-loop runs receive no route map and no fixed migration events; logged migrations only affect fixed replay

versions.V0: original scalar service coefficients; KV block pressure/preemption disabled; old migration fit, deterministic
versions.V1: promoted prefill/decode service models; KV block pressure/preemption disabled; old migration fit, deterministic
versions.V2: V1 plus dynamic KV block allocation/growth, sequence cap, and resumed-prefill correction; robust migration mean, deterministic
versions.V3: V2 plus residual-uncertainty sampling for migration duration

controller: greedy rule-based selection of legal pair with positive predicted net gain; this is not a trained PPO checkpoint
fixed_replay_semantics: logged measurement-phase migration time/source/destination/request/cost/status are exogenous; migration predictor and uncertainty are bypassed
migration_pause_caveat: request is blocked during the simulated migration interval, but no measured service-pause label exists; this is an explicit approximation
